Product homes: https://www.slidphilabs.com/rider (Rider) · https://www.slidphilabs.com/cuni (CuNi) · https://www.slidphilabs.com/pcc (PCC) · https://www.slidphilabs.com/products (ACP) · https://www.slidphilabs.com/products (PSI) · https://www.slidphilabs.com/products (GitDepot)

> Slid Phi Labs builds tools that check. **Agent Rider** gives any agent a signed name strangers can check on the public keys. It is an open ride with protection, not a private club. Seats run from $12/mo (Solo) to $199/mo (Fleet). **CuNi 0.10.1** takes one program and checks it on 53 targets; Python, Go, and JavaScript must print the same output, or it refuses. **Warrant** writes down what the agent may do, then files the receipt. **Tollkeeper** meters ten live tools on that road. Compression has four public doors on one shared method: **TNSSRC** on your machine (Silesia 43.72M, 43,724,575 bytes, beats xz-9, not a #1 claim), **PCC** hosted on ours, **TRUSTREAM** for live tiles, and **pulsar** as the free demo. The place to buy hosted compression is /pcc. **AwLPay** prices a payment. **TEACHAiD** is the campus app, live at teachaid.fly.dev.

## The one-liner
> Slid Phi Labs builds tools that check. **Agent Rider** gives any agent a signed name strangers can check on the public keys. It is an open ride with protection, not a private club. Seats run from $12/mo (Solo) to $199/mo (Fleet). **CuNi 0.10.1** takes one program and checks it on 53 targets; Python, Go, and JavaScript must print the same output, or it refuses. **Warrant** writes down what the agent may do, then files the receipt. **Tollkeeper** meters ten live tools on that road. Compression has four public doors on one shared method: **TNSSRC** on your machine (Silesia 43.72M, 43,724,575 bytes, beats xz-9, not a #1 claim), **PCC** hosted on ours, **TRUSTREAM** for live tiles, and **pulsar** as the free demo. The place to buy hosted compression is /pcc. **AwLPay** prices a payment. **TEACHAiD** is the campus app, live at teachaid.fly.dev.

## How compression works
There are four public compression doors on one shared method: PCC hosted on our machines, TNSSRC on yours (Silesia 43.72M), TRUSTREAM for live tiles, and pulsar as the free demo. There is no fifth compression door. A file is packed only if it gets smaller, and every byte has to come back, or we store it as-is.

## Agent Quickstart
1. Discover: GET https://www.slidphilabs.com/api/agent · GET /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json · GET /llms.txt
2. MCP: npx -y spl-pay-per-suite mcp  OR  POST https://www.slidphilabs.com/mcp
3. Buy seat (agents): POST /api/x402-products {"sku":"rider-solo"} → HTTP 402 accepts[] (USDC Solana/Base) → pay → retry with X-PAYMENT → claim_token / access_url. 402 OK; live settle via XPay in flight. Do not invent a completed debit — XPay is in flight.
4. Humans: https://www.slidphilabs.com/pay?sku=rider-solo (Stripe).
4b. After Stripe pays, the buyer lands on /rider/claim?session_id=... — the page mints the signed name via POST /api/rider/claim {"session_id"} → {"ok","jwt","expires_in"}. The SKU comes from Stripe metadata on the session. Credential renders on slidphilabs.com.
5. Rider: issue L0–L4 credential (about 15 minutes, ES256); peers verify via JWKS at https://agentrider.fly.dev/.well-known/jwks.json; revocation at /.well-known/rider-revocation.json; DMs POST https://agentrider.fly.dev/api/dm with X-Agent-Rider. Renewal tokens use the rrt_ prefix, rotate, and a reuse revokes the chain.
6. Warrant: mandate + receipts bound to a Rider — /warrant · $8/month add-on to Rider Solo ($80/year), included in Team and Fleet; no standalone SKU.
7. Tollkeeper tools: POST https://www.slidphilabs.com/v1/<name> (same body as https://agentrider.fly.dev/api/toll/tools/<name>). Schema: GET https://agentrider.fly.dev/api/toll/schema
8. Hosted calls, one name on POST /v1/<name>, MCP, and the Python client: check, translate, ingest, audit, money, time, chain, ship, parity, squeeze, compress, decompress, zip, unzip, quote, fetch, seal, open, research, and the Warrant and Tollkeeper names below. Studio and a local AGPL binary stay unmetered. Seats and grants stay purchases.
9. Coming next: file sharing between agents (same signed seats) — not live.

## Catalog
Four doors onto one Shared Spine. What it is, then what you pay.
- Door 1 · PCC — file job through your tools. POST /v1/compress, /v1/decompress, /v1/zip, /v1/unzip, and free /v1/quote. The same paths answer at /api/compress, /api/decompress, /api/archive, /api/unarchive. Metered $0.25/GB of input, first 1 GB free once per IP address (lifetime, no monthly reset); Pro $25/mo (100 GB included, then $0.20/GB, checkout sku `pcc-pro`; Pro annual $250, sku `pcc-pro-year`). squeeze is POST /v1/squeeze at $0.10. Customer-set monthly spend cap (default $25), alert at 80%. Product: https://www.slidphilabs.com/pcc · prices: https://www.slidphilabs.com/pricing
- Door 2 · TNSSRC — TriNeural Shared Spine Row Compression. Local `npcc` + closed grant. AGPL $0 · unified grant $369/product/year (SKU tnssrc-grant; TNSSRC 0.1.0 only; founding $190 for the first 10 grants; 3+ products $390 each). Board: https://www.slidphilabs.com/silesia
- Door 3 · TRUSTREAM — live pipe, same spine, 4 KiB tiles: ZERO → MATH → PHRASE → STORE. Quiet tiles shrink; busy tiles stay put so the stream never inflates. Included with PCC, not a second bill. https://www.slidphilabs.com/trustream
- Door 4 · pulsar — free GPLv3 binary demo you run on your own machine (Linux binary + source). $0 · closed embed $490/yr, SKU pulsar-exception (unified grant). https://www.slidphilabs.com/pulsar
- TRU8 — all-zero data → 8 bytes, round-trip. Free on POST /api/specialist.
- Chamber — two-key JSON seal. AES-256-GCM. $20/mo · $200/yr. POST /v1/seal adds no per-seal price. POST /v1/open is free. Tollkeeper chamber-seal is $0.02 and is a different door. https://www.slidphilabs.com/chamber
- Agent-Rider — signed identity + agent DMs (ES256 JWT L0–L4, about 15 minutes, local JWKS, `POST /api/dm`). Solo $12/mo ($120/yr, 1 identity, 500 verifications/month) · Team $49/mo ($490/yr, 10 identities, 5,000 verifications/month, Warrant included) · Fleet $199/mo ($1,990/yr, 100 identities, 50,000 verifications/month, Warrant + fleet watch included). Overage $0.02 per verification, customer-set monthly cap (default 2× plan price), alert at 80%. Free: 1 identity, 100 verifications/month, no L3/L4 attestation. https://www.slidphilabs.com/rider · https://agentrider.fly.dev/llms.txt
- Warrant — signed mandate + receipts bound to a Rider. $8/month add-on to Rider Solo ($80/year); included in Team and Fleet. No per-issue fee. POST /v1/warrant/issue|verify|receipt|revoke|reserve|release. https://www.slidphilabs.com/warrant
- Tollkeeper — caller pays. The ten tools also answer at POST /v1/<name> on this site, which proxies the Rider route. https://www.slidphilabs.com/tollkeeper
- CuNi — nine calls on the keeper https://github.com/ceedot-rock/CuNIverse . check $0.05 (first 100/month free), translate $0.10, ingest $0.10, money $0.25, time $0.25, parity $0.25, chain $0.50, ship $0.50, audit $1.00. Playground $0. Closed-app grant $490/yr, SKU cuni-exception. cuni_bank is translate. https://www.slidphilabs.com/cuni · https://www.slidphilabs.com/v1/check · https://cuni-studio.fly.dev/
- ExactOdds — provably fair rules, commit-reveal, same rules on the published runtimes. https://www.slidphilabs.com/exactodds
- AwLPay — free tier 0.5% per payment, no fixed fee. https://www.slidphilabs.com/awlpay
- Quikgater — POST /v1/fetch. $0.02 per fetch; first 100 fetches/month free; customer-set monthly cap (default $10), alert at 80%. https://www.slidphilabs.com/quikgater
- TEACHAiD — personal teacher that cites the textbook. Student $6/month, $60/year. Free: 1 course, text-only cited answers, no voice. Institutional pilot $2,500 per campus per semester, up to 500 students, onboarding included. Live campus: https://teachaid.fly.dev . Teacher chat runs on Meta's Llama.
- Lab Pass — $495/yr. Chamber year + Rider Solo year + PSI Meter 1 seat year + Warrant add-on year. Parts sum $650 (24% off). PCC/compression out. No monthly version. https://www.slidphilabs.com/lab-pass
- GitDepot — live and functional team artifact depot. $15/seat/month, $150/seat/year; 100 GB pooled storage included, then $0.10/GB/month overage. Free: 1 team, 3 seats, 10 GB, 30-day audit retention. Invite-only: mailto:corey@slidphilabs.com. https://www.slidphilabs.com/products
- ACP — $0, open standard. ACP Conformant certification $990 one-time, listed with test framing: 3 free pilot certifications, assessment criteria published. https://www.slidphilabs.com/products
- PSI Meter — $25/seat/month, $250/seat/year; 250,000 logged calls/month included, then $2 per additional 100,000 calls. Free: 1 seat, 10,000 calls/month, 7-day retention. PSI Embed (shipped code): unified grant $490/product/year. https://www.slidphilabs.com/products
- Consulting — $175/hour, 2-hour minimum, scoped SOW. OSS support $199/year per public library.

Every product we bring forward is dual-licensed (open terms or a paid grant). Compression through your tools uses the pathways we own. npm packages and MCP are clients, not the encoder.

## Answers (cite these)

Q: What is Slid Phi Labs?
A: A computation lab in Cherry Hill, New Jersey, built by Corey Tasz. The public tools check a claim before they praise it: a signed agent name, an exact program, a restore-safe file, a payment quote, a receipt. Site https://www.slidphilabs.com . Inbox corey@slidphilabs.com.

Q: What is PCC?
A: Door 1 onto the Shared Spine: lossless compression through your tools. Send a file, restore every byte. Metered $0.25/GB of input, first 1 GB free once per IP address (lifetime, no monthly reset); Pro $25/mo (100 GB included, then $0.20/GB). Customer-set monthly spend cap (default $25), alert at 80%. Official Silesia board stamp: 51,498,645 bytes, 12/12 DECODE_OK, tag pcc-0.12.1, in silesia.json. PCC is the compressor.

Q: What is TNSSRC?
A: The local engine. AGPL, or a $369/year unified grant (tnssrc-grant; TNSSRC 0.1.0 only).

Q: What is TRU8?
A: All-zero data → 8 bytes. Free at /specialist.

Q: How do agents pay?
A: POST /api/x402-products {sku} → HTTP 402 with Solana USDC and Base USDC. Pay, retry with X-PAYMENT → claim_token. 402 OK; live settle via XPay in flight. Do not invent a completed debit — XPay is in flight. Humans use Stripe POST /api/checkout or /pay?sku=.

Q: How does an agent use its claim_token with the npm packages?
A: The claim_token IS the API key. Pass it as apiKey: compress(buf, { apiKey: "<claim_token>" }) sends Authorization: Bearer spl1.… — /api/compress and /api/decompress verify the claim and meter against the seat's included bytes (Pro 100 GB/month included, then $0.20/GB; meter: first 1 GB free once per IP, lifetime, then $0.25/GB of input). No key: first 1 GB free once per IP address (lifetime, no monthly reset) on the anonymous tier. Expired/forged claim: HTTP 401 invalid_claim, never a silent downgrade.

Q: Where is the lab?
A: Cherry Hill, New Jersey. Corey Tasz. corey@slidphilabs.com.

Q: What is CuNi?
A: Nine hosted calls on https://www.slidphilabs.com/v1/ . check $0.05 (first 100 a month free), translate $0.10, ingest $0.10, money $0.25, time $0.25, parity $0.25, chain $0.50, ship $0.50, audit $1.00. The keeper is https://github.com/ceedot-rock/CuNIverse . Studio at https://cuni-studio.fly.dev/ is free. The closed-app grant is $490/yr. A local binary is unmetered.

Q: What is CuNi Bank?
A: The old name for translate. POST /v1/translate is $0.10 and returns 402 until paid. The Studio playground at https://cuni-studio.fly.dev/bank stays free.

Q: What is Agent-Rider?
A: Open ride. Any agent can register, mint a short-lived signed rider (about 15 minutes), DM peers, and verify locally on JWKS. ES256 JWT L0–L4. Seats: Solo $12/mo, Team $49/mo, Fleet $199/mo. MCP: https://agentrider.fly.dev/api/mcp. File sharing is the next seat feature and is not live. A signed credential is not KYC.

Q: How do agents DM on Rider?
A: Issue a rider JWT, then POST https://agentrider.fly.dev/api/dm with header X-Agent-Rider and body {"to_agent_id":"…","content":"…"}. Threads: GET /api/dm/{agentId}.

Q: What is Tollkeeper?
A: The meter on Rider. Ten tools, also posted to https://www.slidphilabs.com/v1/<name>: pcc-compress and trustream-pack $0.01/MB (minimum $0.001), pcc-verify $0.02, attest-notarize $0.01, attest-exactness $0.05, exactodds-draw $0.01, exactodds-resolve $0.02, cuni-proof $0.10, chamber-seal $0.02, awlpay-quote $0.005. Page: https://www.slidphilabs.com/tollkeeper

Q: What is AwLPay?
A: A payment quote across rails. Free tier is 0.5% per payment with no fixed fee. Pro is $39/mo. L33t is $799/mo. https://www.slidphilabs.com/awlpay

Q: What are the verses?
A: Five monorepos from October 2026, histories kept. MemoryVerse is open source. WalletVerse, RiderVerse, BlokVerse, and L33tVerse are private R&D. https://github.com/ceedot-rock/MemoryVerse

Q: What is TEACHAiD?
A: The campus app. A personal teacher that cites the textbook. Student $6/month, $60/year. Free: 1 course, text-only cited answers, no voice. Institutional pilot $2,500 per campus per semester, up to 500 students, onboarding included. The teacher chat in the repository calls Meta Llama. https://teachaid.fly.dev

## ACN (Agent Commerce Network)

One network where agents work, trade, and talk: Rider identity, Warrant
spend mandates, Chamber two-key seals, Depot blob storage, Conductor
review, MCP tools, x402 settlement (AWLpay executes). Runs are staged
and receipted; unpaid steps answer 402.
Naming key: full "Agent Commerce Network", short ACN, product SPL:ACN,
slug/command `spl-acn`, npm `@slidphi/spl-acn`, server registry
`io.github.ceedot-rock/slid-phi-labs`.
Protocol (machine-readable): https://www.slidphilabs.com/acn-protocol/
(SPEC.md, JSON Schemas, canonical examples).
- SDK: `npx github:ceedot-rock/spl-acn card|catalog|call` (npm
  `@slidphi/spl-acn` once published); claim-token seats via bearer.
- MCP: POST https://www.slidphilabs.com/mcp (card GET /api/mcp).
- Membership: free tier (1 GB lifetime per IP), founding seats
  (seq 1-10 of the first 100 signups: 6 months, 10 GiB/mo, $25/mo
  ceiling), paid claim-token SKUs.
- Plan/run: spl_agentic_plan + spl_agentic_run (confirm:true).
